item.title: Longitudinal Trajectories of Amyloid-Beta and Cognitive Decline in Aging Populations
item.description:
Overview A comprehensive survival analysis investigating the long-term impact of Amyloid-Beta accumulation on cognitive function.

Problem Motivation The precise temporal relationship between biomarker accumulation and clinical decline remains highly variable and poorly understood at an individualized level.

Methodology Utilized deep survival models and landmark analysis to map individualized risk trajectories.

Key Findings Demonstrated that specific baseline biomarker thresholding can predict severe decline 5-7 years prior to clinical symptoms.
